[1]  නීතිමය ප්‍රතිපාදනය (පවතින නීතිය):  රිමාන්ඩ් (නඩු විභාග වන) භික්ෂූන් වහන්සේලාට හෝ ලිහිල් වැඩ සහිත සිරදඬුවම් (Simple Imprisonment) ලැබූ භික්ෂූන් වහන්සේලාට බන්ධනාගාරය තුළදී තම සිවුර (චීවරය) පැළඳ සිටීමට අවසර ඇත.  නමුත් යම් භික්ෂූන් වහන්සේ නමකට අධිකරණයකින් "බරපතළ වැඩ සහිත සිරදඬුවම්" (Rigorous Imprisonment) නියම වූ විට, උන්වහන්සේට බන්ධනාගාරය විසින් නිකුත් කරනු ලබන නිල ඇඳුම (Prison-issued clothing) හැඳීමට සිදුවන බව පවතින රෙගුලාසිවල සඳහන් වේ. [1, 2, 3]  අතීතයේ (1902 ගැසට් නිවේදන ආදියේ) බන්ධනාගාර ආඥා පනතේ 76 වැනි වගන්තිය යටතේ 217A රෙගුලාසිය ලෙසද මෙවැනි ප්‍රතිපාදන පැවති අතර, වත්මන් යාවත්කාලීන නීතිය තුළ ක්‍රියාත්මක වන්නේ ඉහත සඳහන් කළ 216 වැනි රෙගුලාසියයි. SIVA SRI M ALAGESHAN GORUKKAL  *"Greetings"*  *The Law and Religion of Sri Lanka!*  In Sri Lanka, the law of the judiciary is common to all. There is a question as to whether the Buddhist monks respect the law and justice.  Is drug trafficking, womanizing, alcohol consumption, preaching racism, preaching religious extremism, and inciting violence between ethnic groups the principle of Buddhist Dharma? The Buddha avatar is the ninth avatar of Maha Vishnu. It is distressing to see that the Sri Lankan Buddhist Sanghas have corrupted and deviated from the path of Lord Buddha, the first great preacher of Buddhism and the incarnation of that great personality, who taught the people the principles of life such as non-violent way of life, truth, righteousness, peace and tranquility.  Is it the Buddhist thought to prevent the governments of Sri Lanka from governing and to prevent law and justice from being established by causing violent impacts? It seems to me that they are Buddhist ascetics without the pure thought that all are equal before justice.  Do the Sri Lankan Buddhist monks want to put the underworld of corruption and poisonous drugs on the throne of power with their blessings?  While ordinary people respectfully honor the law of the judiciary, it seems as if the Buddhist monks who are supposed to preach righteous teachings to the people are disrespecting the law of the courts in Sri Lanka. Punishment is given only after crimes are proven. What justice is there in pressuring the President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka to revoke that punishment or to save them from punishment?  Why did the venerable Buddhist monks not prevent the spread of drugs, murder, robbery, bribery, government corruption, and underworld murderous gangs within our country? Why did they not help agriculture, which is the first step in the development of my motherland which is suffering in poverty, and why did they not come forward to fulfill the needs of our helpless Sri Lankan people?  Therefore, are the Sri Lankan Buddhist monks using the noble name of Lord Buddha to operate villains within the saffron robe?  Is this the service that the Buddhist monks do to Lord Buddha, who is the ninth incarnation of Maha Vishnu? Is this the beauty with which you adorn the throne of our country? Is this the Dharma that the Buddhist monks preach to the Sri Lankan government?  Where is the life philosophy of Lord Buddha who never saved anything for himself? Were the luxury vehicles, high-class soft mattresses, palatial residences, grants and aids given by the government, and government recognition given in his name, all given to lead criminals, the country, and the government on the wrong path????????? If Dharma ever gets angry one day, it will end up as a danger to the Buddhist monks in Sri Lanka who abet crimes........
